usage: Used to refer to the reason or cause of something
Often appears in explanations or justifications
Commonly paired with 點解 (why) or 因為 (because)

examples.jyutping: ngo5 m4 zi1 dou3 jyun4 jan1 hai6 mat1
examples.meaning: I don’t know what the reason is.

examples.sentence: 呢個就係佢離開嘅原因。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 zau6 hai6 keoi5 lei4 hoi1 ge3 jyun4 jan1
examples.meaning: This is the reason he left.
